title: Will any of the Source Agencies report that James Talarico attends an in-person rally with Barack Obama?
rules: If James Talarico attends an in-person rally with Barack Obama after Issuance and before Nov 3, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: Both Barack Obama and the named candidate must be physically present at the same rally; virtual or recorded appearances, such as video messages or ads, do not qualify.

blind.reasoning: Obama appeared with Talarico in May, but at a taco-restaurant stop, not a rally, and probably before issuance. With about two weeks left, his announced fall rallies are in Ohio, Michigan, Georgia, Illinois and Mississippi, not Texas. The race is close and important for Senate control, so a late Texas rally is plausible, but it isn't announced and Obama has historically skipped Texas rallies.
blind.falsifier: An announcement or report of Obama headlining a Texas rally (e.g., Houston, Dallas, San Antonio) with Talarico on stage before Nov 3, 2026.

final.reasoning: A price around 0.53 suggests no confirmed Obama–Talarico rally has been announced, and Obama's known late-October schedule leaves no Texas stop in my results. I moved toward the market because my research was cut short, but my estimate is still below the midpoint.
